brief.headline: SK Hynix 2026 HBM Sold Out; Samsung HBM4E Samples Live; DRAM/NAND Q2 Pricing +58-75% QoQ
brief.summary: <cite index="7-1,7-22">SK Hynix's entire 2026 HBM allocation is sold out, with shortages projected into 2027.</cite> <cite index="11-7,11-8">Conventional DRAM contract prices rose 58-63% QoQ in Q2 2026 following a 90-95% surge in Q1, while NAND Flash prices jumped 70-75% QoQ in Q2 after ~60% in Q1.</cite> <cite index="21-5,21-9">The four biggest hyperscalers—Microsoft, Meta, Amazon, and Alphabet—will collectively spend roughly $700 billion on capex in 2026, nearly double 2025 levels.</cite> <cite index="32-6,32-7">TSMC is scaling CoWoS capacity from ~35,000 wafers/month in late 2024 to a projected 130,000 wafers/month by end-2026, with Nvidia securing over 60% of total CoWoS capacity for 2025 and 2026.</cite>
brief.pair_trade_view: <cite index="44-3,44-5">SK Hynix market cap reached 93.2% of Samsung Electronics' (up from 46.5% a year ago), driven by SK's 258.4% YTD gain vs Samsung's 164.4%, narrowing the gap to a record-low 119 trillion won.</cite> <cite index="47-5">SK Hynix commands over 50% HBM market share and is the primary HBM3E supplier to Nvidia.</cite> <cite index="45-8">Samsung held 35% HBM market share in Q3 2025 vs SK's 53%, but Samsung in May 2026 became the first to ship HBM4E samples.</cite> <cite index="42-12">Barclays prefers SK Hynix for higher HBM exposure and flagged a potential U.S. ADR listing as an additional catalyst.</cite> Long SK vs Samsung on HBM3E/4 transition timing; Samsung catch-up narrative at risk if HBM4 qualification slips. Watch relative valuation compression risk if Samsung closes yield gap faster than consensus.

memory_cycle.notes: <cite index="2-1">Goldman Sachs forecasts a 4.9% DRAM supply deficit in 2026.</cite> <cite index="3-11">BofA forecasts global DRAM revenue to surge 51% and NAND 45% YoY in 2026, with ASPs rising 33% and 26% respectively, defining 2026 as a 'supercycle similar to the 1990s boom'.</cite> <cite index="12-22">Hyperscaler capex among the top eight cloud providers is projected to exceed $600 billion in 2026, a 40% YoY increase.</cite> <cite index="13-20,13-21">Prices expected to peak later in 2026 but remain elevated through 2028.</cite> HBM capacity conversion (3:1 vs DDR5) and enterprise SSD prioritization structurally constraining consumer supply.

brief.hbm_pulse: <cite index="3-15">BofA estimates the 2026 HBM market at $54.6 billion, +58% YoY.</cite> <cite index="3-16">Goldman Sachs forecasts HBM demand for ASIC-based AI chips to surge 82%, accounting for one-third of the market.</cite> <cite index="3-24">UBS predicts SK Hynix will achieve ~70% market share in HBM4 for Nvidia's Rubin platform in 2026.</cite> <cite index="4-13">SK Hynix announced iHBM thermal architecture, cutting thermal resistance by 30%, targeting next-gen HBM5 accelerators.</cite> <cite index="35-1,35-2">TSMC's tight CoWoS supply is pushing SK Hynix to work with Intel on advanced packaging, diversifying the 2.5D supply chain.</cite> <cite index="5-3">Samsung plans to expand HBM production capacity by ~50% in 2026; SK Hynix is increasing infrastructure investment more than 4x prior plans.</cite> Allocation politics through 2027; hyperscalers locked in long-term agreements.

news_pulse.headline: SK Hynix 2026 HBM Capacity Fully Sold Out, $1T Market Cap Crossed
news_pulse.implication: <cite index="7-19,7-22,7-24">SK Hynix surged 14.9% to cross $1T market cap, triggering KOSPI algorithmic halt at all-time high of 8,457; shares up ~250% YTD, entire 2026 HBM allocation sold out.</cite> Supply constraint now gating AI training/inference scaling globally.

news_pulse.headline: Barclays Raises SK Hynix Target to €2,300, Samsung to $7,300 on Memory Tightness Through 2027
news_pulse.implication: <cite index="42-2,42-6">Barclays lifted SK Hynix target to €2,300 from €1,100 and Samsung GDR target to $7,300 from $4,250; global DRAM wafer capacity now expected to grow 18% YoY by end-2027, up from 14% by end-2026.</cite> Upward estimate revisions and multiple re-rating in progress.

news_pulse.headline: Hyperscaler Capex Hits $700B in 2026, Nearly Doubles YoY
news_pulse.implication: <cite index="21-13,21-14,21-15,21-16">Meta went from $13B capex in Q1 2025 to $20B in Q1 2026; Alphabet from $17B to $36B; Microsoft from $17B to $31B; Amazon from ~$25B to $44B.</cite> Two-thirds directed to short-lived assets (GPUs/CPUs), implying rapid depreciation and margin pressure.

news_pulse.headline: TSMC CoWoS Capacity Doubling to 130K Wafers/Month by End-2026; Nvidia Locks 60%
news_pulse.implication: <cite index="33-6,33-7">TSMC scaling CoWoS from ~35K wafers/month (late 2024) to 130K by end-2026; Nvidia secured over 60% of total CoWoS capacity for 2025-26.</cite> <cite index="36-2">TSMC plans to outsource 240K-270K CoWoS wafers annually in 2026 to Amkor (180K-190K) and SPIL (60K-80K).</cite> Packaging no longer binding constraint for tier-1 customers.

news_pulse.headline: DRAM +58-63% QoQ in Q2, NAND +70-75% After Q1's +90-95% / +55-60%
news_pulse.implication: <cite index="11-9,11-10">DRAM suppliers reallocating capacity toward AI applications, NAND increasingly directed to enterprise SSDs; cloud providers securing supply through long-term agreements, meaningful capacity expansion not expected until late 2027.</cite> Consumer DRAM/NAND rationed through at least H1 2027.

news_pulse.headline: Samsung, SK Hynix, SKT Gain Access to Anthropic's Mythos AI Security Model
news_pulse.implication: <cite index="39-12,39-20">Samsung Electronics, SK Hynix, and SK Telecom joined Anthropic's Project Glasswing, gaining selective access to Mythos cybersecurity model.</cite> Deepens AI ecosystem ties; indirect validation of memory supply partnership.

news_pulse.headline: Samsung-SK Hynix Market Cap Gap Narrows to Record 119T Won; Hana Warns Reversal = Bull Top
news_pulse.implication: <cite index="44-21">Hana Securities warns if SK Hynix market cap overtakes Samsung, it could signal the current bull market based on earnings growth is ending, citing 2000 tech bubble precedent when Cisco overtook MSFT/GE.</cite> Concentration risk: SK+Samsung now >40% of KOSPI.

news_pulse.headline: Jensen Huang Korea Visit Expected ~June 5; Samsung/SK Hynix Named Top Beneficiaries
news_pulse.implication: <cite index="43-12,43-13">Hana Securities: 'The companies that most clearly hold that bottleneck are still SK hynix and Samsung Electronics.' During Oct 2025 visit, SK surged 22%, Samsung +6.3%.</cite> Catalyst for HBM4 qualification/capacity announcements.

brief.derivatives_signal: No structured options data in payload. <cite index="7-8,7-23">SK Hynix and Samsung together exceed 40% of KOSPI, creating systemic concentration risk.</cite> <cite index="41-19">Samsung/SK single-stock leverage ETFs launched Nov 27 reached ~6T won net assets by Dec 1, with 40s-aged investors comprising 28.9% of buyers.</cite> Retail leverage accelerating into rally extension. Volatility likely to spike on any HBM qualification delay or hyperscaler capex guidance cut. Monitor KOSPI 200 futures and USD/KRW for macro hedge flows.
watch_for_next_3h: Jensen Huang Korea arrival/meeting announcements (~June 5) for HBM4/capacity commitments
Any Samsung HBM4E qualification update from Nvidia/hyperscalers (timing vs SK Hynix HBM4)
Microsoft/Meta/Alphabet commentary on Q2 GPU delivery timelines and CoWoS allocation
TrendForce or DRAMeXchange spot pricing updates (mid-week refresh) for June contract negotiations
Korean won volatility if KOSPI concentration triggers foreign selling or regulatory commentary
